title: Compact interactive series: gesture-priority, token-driven contrast and perf tuning
creator: Maya Patel
description: Problem: our high-density time-series widgets are used in constrained UI surfaces (sidebars, in-app panels). Current legends and tooltips are visually heavy, cause multiple repaints on pointermove, and have accessibility gaps (screen-reader summaries are verbose and obscured by live updates). Goals: 1) Design a compact legend/tooltip pattern that prioritizes gesture-friendly hit targets and reduces hover repaint frequency. 2) Drive contrast and spacing from tokens so teams can enable 'compact' mode via tokens only. 3) Define perf-friendly interaction rules (throttle, offscreen rendering, reduced-motion fallback). 4) Provide clear a11y semantics: concise aria-live summaries, keyboard-first focus order, and explicit touch fallback behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Compact legend variant (max 3 rows) implemented in Figma with token mapping for spacing, type, and color
Interaction spec that limits pointermove updates to 30Hz by default and enables a developer override
Screen-reader summary string pattern defined (series name + latest X value + delta) and verified with VoiceOver and NVDA
Reduced-motion and low-power fallback documented: no hover expansion, single-line tooltip, and rasterized static snapshot option
Performance targets: interactive hover paint < 8ms on median mid-range laptop; series hover path reused from offscreen canvas when available
Design tokens added to the chart tokens list (compact-legend-gap, compact-legend-font-scale, tooltip-min-hit-size) and example mappings in the tokens spec

notes_for_engineering: Key implementation hints: - Use a small client-side debounce (33ms) for pointermove by default; expose config to adjust. - Provide an API hook for 'summaryString(seriesId)' so apps can localize or change phrasing. - When offscreen canvas is available, draw legend thumbnails once and composite; fall back to CSS sprites when not. - Map tokens: compact-legend-gap, compact-legend-font-scale, compact-legend-bg-alpha, tooltip-min-hit-size. - Implement aria-live politeness='polite' and update suppression if updates > 3/sec.
qa_steps: Run axe-core audit on compact frames and fix any contrast failures (contrast ratio target >= 4.5:1 for text in compact mode)
Validate screen-reader flow: Tab to legend, focus series, press Enter to hear summary; confirm NVDA/VoiceOver output matches summary pattern
Measure hover paint times with Chrome performance tab: median < 8ms on test machine (Intel i5), flag regressions
Toggle reduced-motion and low-power mode in browser; confirm tooltip expansion is disabled and a single-line summary is shown
Integration test: run storybook snapshot tests for compact legend in Light/Dark themes with token overrides
metrics: First interaction latency (TTFI) for legend hover
